headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 30, 2026**
article:
The Chicago White Sox secured a 9-3 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Junior Perez leading the offense with a home run and three RBIs. Erick Fedde earned the win, while Tyler Schweitzer secured the save. The Texas Rangers also won, taking down the Cleveland Guardians 4-2 behind Jacob deGrom's 7.0 innings pitched with 9 strikeouts and 2 earned runs. Joc Pederson led the Rangers' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs.

Several players have been placed on the injured list, affecting their teams' lineups. Miami Marlins right-handed pitcher Anthony Bender has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right shin stress reaction. The Houston Astros have also placed shortstop Jeremy Peña on the 10-day injured list with a left calf strain. Other teams have made similar moves, including the Cincinnati Reds, Baltimore Orioles, Seattle Mariners, Chicago Cubs, and Athletics.

The Seattle Mariners have bolstered their roster with the addition of first baseman Buddy Kennedy, acquired from the San Francisco Giants in exchange for cash. The Athletics also made a trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Hayden Juenger from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for catcher Owen Carapellotti. The Chicago Cubs acquired left-handed pitcher David Peterson from the New York Mets in exchange for third baseman Cole Mathis.

top_news.title: **Rangers Take Down Guardians in 4-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Texas Rangers secured a 4-2 win over the Cleveland Guardians, with Jacob deGrom earning the win after pitching 7.0 innings with 9 strikeouts and 2 earned runs. Joc Pederson led the Rangers' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Suffer Shutout Loss to Phillies**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates fell to the Philadelphia Phillies 8-0 in a one-sided matchup. Trea Turner led the Phillies' offense with a 2-hit, 3-RBI performance, including a 9th home run of the season.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Yankees 9-3**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a dominant 9-3 victory over the New York Yankees, with Riley Greene leading the charge at the plate. Greene's impressive performance included two home runs and three RBIs, while Tarik Skubal pitched 6.0 innings with 9 strikeouts and just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Marlins' Anthony Bender Lands on 15-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Miami Marlins right-handed pitcher Anthony Bender has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right shin stress reaction.

top_news.title: **Mariners Acquire Buddy Kennedy in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners have bolstered their roster with the addition of first baseman Buddy Kennedy, acquired from the San Francisco Giants in exchange for cash. Kennedy joins the Mariners in a move that aims to strengthen the team's lineup.
